title: Senior NSA official blocks a finding from reaching President Bush

tellings.quote:
We were going to tell Bush
something we had discovered.
And she said, "Nope, I'm not going to
let you do that."

plain: Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the NSA, says that in the 2000s his team had discovered something and planned to tell President George W. Bush, but a senior official above them refused: 'Nope, I'm not going to let you do that.' Haseltine tells Michels this as something he was part of, and he does not say what the finding was. If true, it would show information being stopped before it reached the president.
